The '''Tenth Army''', also known as '''Crimson Dagger Command''', was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and later [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Sector Army/Legends|Sector Army]] charged with the defense of the [[Quelii Oversector]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

During the Clone wars, the 10th Army's primary role was to defend the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] portion of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]. Other missions included the reinforcement of the [[Ninth Army|9th Sector Army]] and the prevention of any [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] incursion among the [[Council of Neutral Systems/Legends|neutral systems]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

After the [[Declaration of a New Order]] resulting in the creation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Sector Army was placed under command of [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Tanniel]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Crimson Dagger Command was engaged in a [[Ciutric Offensive|campaign]] against the [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]]. [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Terrinald Screed/Legends|Terrinald Screed]] and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Hurst Romodi/Legends|Hurst Romodi]], respectively in command of the fleet and the ground forces, were victorious and became two of the first heroes of the Empire.<ref name="TEGTW" />
